product.olivetti-lsx-5025e.summary: The E variant of the LSX 5025, identified by its BA386 board.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025e.history: An Italian tax administration equipment inventory identifies 23 Olivetti servers under the LSX 5025E designation.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025e.architecture: The board reference distinguishes the variant. Total Hardware 99 lists the BA386 with a 66 MHz 486DX2, up to 256 MB, and 128 or 512 KB of cache.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025e.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025e.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-lsx-5025e.veneto-invent: Agenzia delle Entrate, Veneto equipment transfer inventory, annex
product.olivetti-lsx-5025e.th99-board: Total Hardware 1999, Olivetti LSX 5025E BA386 board settings
